environment.description: EKS pod running with IAM role arn:aws:iam::112233445566:role/stream-processor-prod attached via IRSA. The role has s3:PutObject on the target bucket and no permission boundary. The pod runs as root in a privileged namespace with hostPath /tmp mounted. The workDir /tmp/stream-processor is world-writable. Kafka topic accepts messages from any authenticated producer.

config.iam_policy: s3:PutObject, s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::data-lake-prod/*, sts:AssumeRole on *
